doc.title: Forklift and Pedestrian Safety
doc.purpose: Keep forklifts and people apart in the warehouse and at the dock doors.

roles.name: Forklift Driver
roles.does: Holds a current licence and does the daily check.

roles.name: Anyone
roles.does: Walks only in marked walkways and reports every near miss.

parameters.quote: Maximum speed is 5 mph everywhere inside the building.
Stop if a pedestrian is within 3 metres.

parameters.what: no-stacking distance from corner or dock door
parameters.quote: Nothing is stacked within 2 metres of a corner or a dock door where it could block a driver's view.

rules.statement: Forklifts may not exceed 5 mph anywhere inside the building.
rules.quote: Maximum speed is 5 mph everywhere inside the building.

rules.topic: who checks the dock before entering a trailer
rules.statement: The Forklift Driver confirms wheels are chocked and the dock leveler is locked before entering a trailer.
rules.quote: Before entering a trailer: wheels chocked, dock leveler (DOCK-1 to DOCK-4) locked in place.
